AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  May 8, 2024
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair Ghazarian called the meeting to order at 5:04 pm.

  Present: Rihn, Harutyunyan, Megrabyan, Hatamian, Chair Ghazarian
  Absent: None

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration for the minutes of the April10, 2024 meeting.

  Motion: Harutyunyan  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  None

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Paula Adams reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

S.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Paula Adams reviewed the Eligible Lists Established Report.

6.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL CIVIL ENGINEERING ASSOCIATE
  —

  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Civil Engineering Associate as submitted.
  An updated version of the document was provided to the Commission. Commissioner Rihn recommended
  that the probationary period as well as filing status of the individual selection process be included into the
  job bulletins.

  Motion: Rihn  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

7.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL—POLICE LIEUTENANT
  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Police Lieutenant as submitted.
  Commission Megrabyan requested that the high school diploma requirement language be removed. Paula
  Adams requested that the experience requirement should state: “one of which must have been in Patrol as a
  field supervisor.”

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Rihn
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

8.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL PUBLIC WORKS ADMINISTRATOR
  —

  Action: Approve the revised class specification for Public Works Administrator as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of May 8, 2024
  Page 2 of 3

9.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL ELECTRICIAN —

  Action: Approve the class specification for Electrician as submitted.

  Motion: Rihn  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
10.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL FIREFIGHTER RECRUIT/PARAMEDIC LATERAL
  —  -

  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Firefighter Recruit / Paramedic Lateral as submitted.
  -

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

11.  REPORTS INFORMATION
  -

  a) Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Report (May 8, 2024)

  Paula Adams reviewed the Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Reports.

  Item 13 was taken out of order.

13.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Paula Adams stated that the Human Resources Department did a review over the last two years and sent a
  dozen class specifications to a law firm to ensure proper FLSA designation. Ms. Adams also stated that
  training will be provided to Human Resources staff to ensure that FLSA designations are done properly.

  Commissioner Harutyunyan stated that his term serving on the Civil Service Commission has come to an end.
  Commissioner Harutyunyan shared his sentiments and gratitude for his time on the Commission.

  Chair Ghazarian, Commissioner Megrabyan, Commissioner Hatamian, and Commissioner Rihn shared their
  appreciation of Commissioner Harutyunyan’s time on the Commission.

12.  CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline  —  Housing Technician

  Reported Out
  The Commission voted unanimously to uphold the dismissal of the employee.
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of May 8, 2024
  Page 3 of 3

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 7:21 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and correct record of our proceedings of May 8, 2024.

  Garo Ghazarian, Chair
